decisions.reason: As a recently launched line that was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it likely faces somewhat higher uncertainty and lower internal aspiration attainment, but a German metal-products SME would usually keep it for another year unless early feedback is clearly poor.

Because it had its own product page and appears close to the firm's existing fabricated-pipe-support business, management would likely judge it as a reasonable fit and retain it while learning more about demand.

This product also had its own page and fits the firm's established metal bracket/support capabilities, so with no strong evidence of underperformance the firm would likely continue it under bounded-rational trial-and-adjustment.
